---
title: "An empty filename on an executed cell"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  html: default
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

Quarto keeps the filename of an executed cell in its own registry, not on the
code block, so the filter reads it there. An empty filename read there is
still a filename, and the window keeps an empty title.

```{r}
#| filename: ""
a <- 1
```
